# adds_gpo_wmi_filter (Resource)

Assigns a WMI filter (`adds_wmi_filter`) to a GPO (`gPCWQLFilter`). A GPO can only have one WMI filter at a time, so this resource is authoritative for the whole attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_backup_gpo" "servers_baseline" {
  backup_name = "Servers Baseline"
  target_name = "Servers Baseline"
  path        = "backup_gpo"
}

resource "adds_wmi_filter" "windows_server_2022" {
  name = "Windows Server 2022 only"

  queries = [
    {
      query = "SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE Version LIKE \"10.0.20348%\" AND ProductType = \"3\""
    }
  ]
}

resource "adds_gpo_wmi_filter" "servers_baseline" {
  gpo        = adds_backup_gpo.servers_baseline.target_name
  wmi_filter = adds_wmi_filter.windows_server_2022.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gpo` (String) GPO to assign the filter to, by GUID or display name.
- `wmi_filter` (String) WMI filter to assign, by GUID or filter name. Changing this re-assigns the filter.

### Read-Only

- `gpo_dn` (String) Distinguished name of `gpo`.
- `id` (String) Resolved GUID of `gpo`.
- `wmi_filter_guid` (String) Resolved GUID of `wmi_filter`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# GPO WMI filter assignments are imported by the GPO's GUID.
terraform import adds_gpo_wmi_filter.servers_baseline "12345678-90ab-cdef-1234-567890abcdef"
```
